name: Moonlight Castle
source:
Moonlight Castle is a murder mystery, supernatural, slice of life, romance visual novel. It’s a story that revolves around 8 college students getting together to explore a ghost castle named after a rumor that spread on the internet. You will live their college life during the day, hang out and socialize with your friends in the afternoon and then investigate the ancient ruins when the sky becomes dark.

[From [url=https://mateko.itch.io/moonlight-castle]Itch.io[/url]]
